items.item_text: Experience with Windows Server or Linux server installation, configuration, patching, administration and security hardening.
Experience supporting virtualized server infrastructure, such as Nutanix AHV, VMware or Hyper-V, including virtual machine provisioning and guest operating system maintenance.
Experience supporting a migration from on premises Active Directory to Microsoft Entra ID, or supporting a hybrid identity environment.

Experience supporting computing attached to laboratory instruments, imaging or picture archiving and communication systems, or other specialized scientific or clinical equipment in a research, clinical or regulated environment. Experience with scripting and automation, such as PowerShell, Bash or Python, to automate deployment, configuration, reporting and routine administrative tasks.
Experience with vulnerability management tooling, such as Tenable or Nessus, and with remediation and reporting workflows.

Experience with asset discovery and inventory platforms, such as Lansweeper, including reporting and data quality maintenance. Experience with backup and restore operations, including restore testing and documentation.

Experience with UC Davis campus computing resources, including campus network and address management services, security operations, data center and communication resources, and the ability to use these resources for problem resolution.

Experience developing and applying creative and innovative concepts to problem resolution. Experience working as a team player in a service oriented environment, including guiding, reviewing or mentoring the work of student employees or junior technical staff.
50% - Desktop, Endpoint and Mobile Device Support and Engineering
15% - Laboratory, Imaging and Specialized Research Systems Support
Knowledge of UC Business and Finance Bulletin IS-3, HIPAA, or other regulated or protected data requirements in a research environment.
